title: Spicy Red Snapper Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Chinese-inspired dish featuring snapper, served in a bowl with an assortment of spices and vegetables.
instructions: Season snapper fillets with egyptian spices.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced jagged red chilies and cook for 2 minutes.
Add snapper fillets and sear for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
While snapper is baking, mix soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Remove snapper from the oven and brush with the soy sauce mixture.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve in a bowl.
